messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-08-07] incident-review/INC-2025-017: INC-2025-017 review. What happened: auth-gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02. Why: an expired intermediate certificate. Follow-up decision: certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, because an expired intermediate certificate took logins down in INC-2025-017.
- [2025-06-27] handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-11: the notification service went to the Dune team, not team Cinder. The Cinder team never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-02-05] incident-review/INC-2025-004: Incident review INC-2025-004. The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01. Root cause: a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. Decision: notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds, because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes during INC-2025-004.
- [2025-09-30] standup/atlas/2025-09-30: Decision: billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. The billing API now depends on the feature flag service. The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.
- [2026-01-30] standup/cinder/2026-01-30: We agreed today that auth-gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. The reason is that the security audit flagged long-lived tokens.
- [2025-10-07] incident-review/INC-2025-023: Incident review INC-2025-023. The indexer served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03. Root cause: a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. Decision: reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.
- [2026-03-09] handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2026-02-11: the flags service went to team Atlas, not Dune. Dune never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2026-03-11] standup/cinder/2026-03-11: No deploys to Ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close.
- [2025-09-02] standup/atlas/2025-09-02: Decided in today's standup: clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds, since feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak and most of them were identical.
- [2025-12-18] standup/boreal/2025-12-18: Rotation day for Boreal: Marcus hands the pager to Lena. Boreal adopted a weekly dependency update day.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: The job scheduler lives with the Ember team. For the record, the authentication gateway is owned by Ember.
- [2025-05-30] incident-review/INC-2025-011: Review of INC-2025-011 (Ledger, 2025-05-24). The root cause was an index missing after the schema migration. We decided that ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
- [2026-05-19] incident-review/INC-2026-009: Incident review INC-2026-009. The scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. Root cause: two leaders elected during a network partition. Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21: Decision: the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff, because the flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16: The Atlas team saw that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-08-19] standup/dune/2025-08-19: The job scheduler's deploy window changes today: it is now on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. The old slot (Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC) is retired.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08: For the record, the ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.
- [2025-07-03] handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction: Fixing an error in the 2025-06-09 handover: the new owner of billing-api is Atlas. Team Boreal was recorded by mistake and never held it.
- [2026-05-27] standup/atlas/2026-05-27: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. The Atlas team noticed that search-indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. The catalog still relies on the resizer; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-12-19] handover/2025-12-19-catalog: Atlas is taking over the product catalog from the Cinder team, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2026-04-14] standup/dune/2026-04-14: Rotation day for the Dune team: Tomasz hands the pager to Farah.
